object: D179 wider input-masked XOR h-map audit
question: Can a 160-bit XOR mask map depending on g, e2, f, and E preserve the coupled equations for the residual class toggles?
number: Exact CEGIS found no map for delta 00002000 after 5 witnesses and no map for delta 00001000 after 4 witnesses; delta 00000400 reached the ten-iteration limit and is inconclusive.
notes: Negative only for the tested constant-mask family. The 00000400 case is not decided by this run; arbitrary nonlinear maps and universal class invariance remain OPEN, with no saving credited.
